== Biography ==
The Ryde alphabetical list names Mr William Glasgow at The Lawn, Spencer Road. The Ancestry index puts William in the address field. His age, family and wider identity are unknown.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/3145/records/16270832 Ancestry, UK City and County Directories, record 3145/16270832].</ref><ref>[https://www.bartiesworld.co.uk/directory-db/diroutput-town.php?loc=1878Ryde&p=9 White’s Directory of Hampshire and the Isle of Wight (1878), Ryde alphabetical list].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
William Maurice Glasgow, baptised at Cowes in 1879, is not identified with the adult listed here.

Identity resolution, 16 November 2026: no existing catalogue profile matched this record. The record defines a distinct documentary person; later life and any relationships beyond those stated in the record remain unresolved. The sourced draft is creation-ready with those limits.
